problem:
I changed my university password this morning.
Now my Windows laptop won't connect to campus Wi-Fi,
but my phone still works.
compressed_context:
1. Open Settings > Network & Internet >Wi-Fi.
2. Select eduroam and enter your currently University Username (e.g., student09)and Password(e.g, P@sswOrd)).
3. If you recently changed your university password Windows may still have the oldpassword cached).
4 Choose "Forget" for existing Edroam network then reconnect usingyour new password.
5.If connection stil fails confirm that University account is active
